modDescription: First Kernstown, 23 March 1862. 62x55 hexes at 250 yd, 3410 unique painted SV_K_col_row tiles (Summer folder) sliced from one continuous painted basemap: early-March tan/brown fields, leafless woods, Valley Pike, creeks, fences, Sandy Ridge stone wall, 1862 Winchester. No hex grid baked into tiles. Scenario .sav is generated on your PC by tools/build_kernstown_map.ps1.
